reason: I already pay my tutor about $100 a month and she corrects my pronunciation in class. My real problem is freezing when I speak without a script, and reading a prepared answer aloud doesn't fix that. I'd maybe try the free 3 a day, but I won't pay for it unless my teacher tells me to.
objection: It only checks pronunciation while I read text. IELTS Speaking is about fluency, vocabulary and grammar when I talk spontaneously, and my tutor already covers pronunciation.
would_change_my_mind: If my tutor or IELTS centre recommended it as homework between lessons, or if it let me answer questions freely without a script and gave feedback on fluency.
